scope: Original Phanes buttons and glyphs aligned with emergence, light and world creation, with coherent world/music styling, legible action/state feedback and usable desktop/phone controls.

intuitiveness.evidence: The custom actions keep readable labels and native buttons; camera aria-pressed, Explore/Create glyph changes, music play/pause/resume and its mobile mirror, keyboard arrangement/reset, focus return and ordinary phone scrolling passed independent checks. However the enlarged default desktop music nodes overlap their controls: at 1440 by 1000, the center of Velvet Circuit's style-weight-2 slider hits Lunar Steps' style-node-3. A user trying to adjust one style can activate another. This is a material input failure, not a minor decorative overlap.

accuracy.evidence: Inspected the generated 24-glyph atlas, its declared hash and provenance, all declared identity inputs, and the actual root/project-path integration. Dynamic glyph/state updates survive runtime text changes; world create, castle brush, undo/redo, camera states, transport, custom range and checkbox operations passed with no captured page/resource errors. The source correctly discloses an opaque RGB atlas. The intended black-background compositing nevertheless does not hold in several deployed contexts, and the default slider hit target routes to the wrong node. These defects prevent the declared legible, usable control scope from being complete.

wowFactor.evidence: The ivory/sage glyph family, opening curves, restrained control surfaces and shared world/music styling give Phanes a coherent original direction. At actual desktop and phone sizes, most labeled action silhouettes are clear. But conspicuous black rectangular tiles remain behind the brand and welcome marks, unselected camera glyphs and every music island mark; the island filter adds a rectangular halo. These production compositing artifacts, combined with crowded default music nodes, materially interrupt the intended finished appearance.

thinkingOutOfTheBox.evidence: The emergence/core motif connects world creation, spatial musical styles, the central pulse and navigation within a consistent material language. Familiar action silhouettes retain their practical meaning, and the implementation uses simple custom transport/direction forms where they improve small-control readability. The concept interprets the project's name and mission without relying on generic sparkle marks or a separate mythology skin. The remaining blockers concern execution rather than a lack of a useful original design idea.

blockingFindings: Fix atlas compositing in every actual context: brand, welcome mark, inactive camera buttons, reset-camera and music islands. Remove visible black rectangular backgrounds and rectangular glow/halo artifacts while preserving glyph contrast. Independently inspect initial, hovered, focused, selected and playing states on desktop and phone. The RGB/screen approach is acceptable only when the actual rendered result is clean; update INTERFACE_ART.md to describe the treatment that works.

Reflow the default music layout for the full enlarged button, label and slider bounds. At 1440x1000, style-island-2 and style-island-3 overlap by 142x22.390625 px, and elementFromPoint at the center of style-weight-2 returns style-node-3. Opposite-side nodes also overlap visually. Require nonintercepted slider/button hit targets after Reset layout across the desktop/tablet breakpoints and 390/360 px phone layouts. Recheck keyboard focus visibility and phone scrolling after changing spacing.
verification: Read reviews/features.json scope and all ten declared inputs, including the complete identity stylesheet and relevant runtime label/state handlers. Inspected the full PNG and supplied final 1440/390/360 images; independently captured desktop welcome/world/music and project-path 390x844 welcome/world/music. In separate Chromium sessions at root http://127.0.0.1:4196/ and http://127.0.0.1:4197/Phanes/, assertion-checked create, castle brush, undo/redo, camera aria state, Explore/Create text/glyph transitions, play/pause/resume with unchanged track ID and mirrored mobile glyph state, arrangement arrows/Enter/reset, normal connection, custom range/checkbox and Escape focus return. Native touch input on phone scrolled the panel 0 to 175 px while preserving all node positions/connections; mobile play/pause/resume and arrangement/reset passed. Phone document width remained 390 px. Page and resource error collections were empty. Independently measured default desktop node rectangles and slider hit targets. Evidence is build/critic/identity-01-evidence.json and build/critic/identity-01-*.png. Inspected the builder's build/logs/identity-build.log; did not independently repeat the complete compiler build for this visual review. Verified the linked Orphic hymn supports the documented first-birth, egg and light association: https://sacred-texts.com/cla/hoo/hoo10.htm; the interface mark remains an original interpretation, not a historical emblem. Fingerprints came from build/tools/phanes.reviews.exe hash <input> before and after the review and matched. This rejection is scoped to interface-identity; no full-world or generative-audio approval is implied, and the user's long-form musical-development requirement remains open.
